facts.fact: Défi Media reports that statements made at police stations, once handwritten in Occurrence Books, have since 2015 been entered in the Crime Occurrence Tracking System; the practice is stated as current at publication, whose date is used.

Défi Media reports that since 2015 the entries are made directly on computers linked to a server, in place of the handwritten Occurrence Books; the practice is stated as current at publication, whose date is used.
